senses.gloss: (b. h. √אל, v. אָלָה; cmp. הָגָה, נקב &c.)to curse.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 18:1">Sifré Num. 18</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 18:21">Num. XVIII, 21</cite>) <he>לאלה שיהו אָלִין בה וכ׳</he> ‘as a curse’ means that people shall curse by her (pointing to her), ‘may happen unto thee what happened to …’.
